title: The Dunwich Horror
summary: In the decayed Massachusetts township of Dunwich, the albino Lavinia Whateley bears a goatish, uncannily precocious son, Wilbur, to an unseen father; as Wilbur ransacks library after library for the Necronomicon and his monstrous, invisible twin swells within the sealed Whateley farmhouse, scholars from Miskatonic University piece together the truth and climb Sentinel Hill to drive the horror back beyond the threshold Yog-Sothoth had opened.
